what: A hidden arrow cell outside the button’s left slides in on hover by 1.2 times the cell width in .5s expo.out, while the text shifts by 2/3 of the cell width and rolls up one line in .6s so the second set stands in place. On leave the line returns in .3s and the text rolls up again (.5s) so the first set rises from below — a green Details button that always rolls upward, both when entering and when leaving

options.push: Amount the line shifts (times the arrow cell width), default 1.2
options.shift: Amount text shifts (times cell width), default .6667
options.roll-out: Duration for cloud and text to return on exit (s), default .5
options.ease: Push curve, default expo.out (clouds and return use power1.out as in the original)
options.[data-fx-part=front]: Arrow slot hidden off to the left (inside inner)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Post cell — holds text (visible set) · next (second set)
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Right arrow slot (optional, does not move)

use: →In detailIn detail→
note: Not applied on touch screens (hover false) — the original also skips hover response on narrow screens

from.where: shared.js .pk-btn (every ”Details” button) — original script.js koalaUI.hoverIn: .c-btn__inner x 1.2× arrow width .5 expo.out, .c-btn__text x width×2/3, .--o·.--t y 0→-100% .6 · hoverOut: inner .3, --o -100→-200%·--t 100→0% .5
